description: Sets an inventory item's photo or the company logo from an image on the web (for example a manufacturer's product photo). The server downloads the image itself, so nothing large passes through the conversation. Only public https:// addresses that return a JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or BMP image (up to 15 MB) work. For a photo the user pasted into the chat, use set_image_from_base64 or get_image_upload_link instead.

imageUrl.description: The https:// address of the image file itself (not a web page that shows it).

inventoryItemId.description: The inventory item id when target is "item" (from get_inventory).

target.description: "item" to set an inventory item's photo (also pass inventoryItemId), or "logo" to set the company logo.

name: set_image_from_url
